THERE WAS NEVER A COLLISION. The 399 reading is RETIRED. Her discard number is 10-044 — Maddy's is 10-008, both of them pushed into Flight 10, thirty-six numbers apart.

EIRWEN IS A SURVIVOR. 06-091, Porcelain Dolls. The survivor-or-citizen dispute is resolved by evidence rather than by choosing: a flight and an ID settle it. AND REMIELLE TOO — 06-089, two numbers away from her girlfriend. They were processed almost back to back and are now dating.

Which means the Banshee citizen list carried TWO women who hold designations. Magnolia, Daisey, Lyric and Alexis remain citizens; Claudia, Orianna and Felicity are still unrecorded; Bell, Elspeth, Hela, Eirwen and Remielle are survivors. Twelve accounted for.
